```{r setup, include=FALSE}
source("../../_shared/template/viscount_rmd_helpers.R")

sett_raw <- jsonlite::fromJSON("early_modern_sahel_sudan_settlements.json", simplifyVector = FALSE)
summary_cache <- jsonlite::fromJSON("early_modern_sahel_sudan_summary_cache.json", simplifyVector = FALSE)

all_keys <- names(sett_raw)
all_entries <- lapply(all_keys, function (k) {
  e <- sett_raw[[k]]
  e$key <- k
  e
})

fmt_eu_coord <- function (x) {
  s <- format(round(as.numeric(x), 2L), nsmall = 2L, trim = TRUE)
  gsub("\\.", ",", s)
}

interp_site_pop <- function (e, yr_num) {
  ps <- e$population
  if (is.null(ps) || length(ps) == 0L) return(NA_real_)
  yrs <- as.numeric(names(ps))
  vals <- as.numeric(unlist(ps))
  ord <- order(yrs)
  yrs <- yrs[ord]
  vals <- vals[ord]
  if (yr_num < yrs[1] || yr_num > yrs[length(yrs)]) return(NA_real_)
  idx <- which(yrs == yr_num)
  if (length(idx) > 0L) return(vals[idx[1]])
  stats::approx(x = yrs, y = vals, xout = yr_num, method = "linear")$y
}

fmt_site_pop <- function (e, yr_num) {
  p <- interp_site_pop(e, yr_num)
  if (is.na(p) || p <= 0) return("-")
  viscount_fmt_pop(p)
}

fmt_site_peak <- function (e) {
  ps <- e$population
  if (is.null(ps) || length(ps) == 0L) return("-")
  yrs <- as.numeric(names(ps))
  vals <- as.numeric(unlist(ps))
  i_pk <- which.max(vals)
  paste0(viscount_fmt_pop(vals[i_pk]), " (", as.integer(yrs[i_pk]), "AD)")
}

iso_map <- c(
  Benin = "BEN",
  `Burkina Faso` = "BFA",
  Cameroon = "CMR",
  `Central African Republic` = "CAF",
  Chad = "TCD",
  Eritrea = "ERI",
  Ethiopia = "ETH",
  Gambia = "GMB",
  Ghana = "GHA",
  Guinea = "GIN",
  `Guinea-Bissau` = "GNB",
  `Ivory Coast` = "CIV",
  Mali = "MLI",
  Mauritania = "MRT",
  Niger = "NER",
  Nigeria = "NGA",
  Senegal = "SEN",
  `Sierra Leone` = "SLE",
  `South Sudan` = "SSD",
  Sudan = "SDN",
  Togo = "TGO"
)

subregion_order <- c(
  "trarza_brakna_mauritania",
  "futa_toro_segou_toucouleur",
  "massina_timbuktu_arma",
  "mossi_kong_wassoulou",
  "sokoto_caliphate_hausaland",
  "bornu_kanem_bagirmi",
  "wadai_dar_al_kuti_tibesti",
  "darfur_kordofan_mahdist",
  "turco_egyptian_mahdist_nile",
  "bahr_el_ghazal_azande_eq"
)

zone_overrides <- c(
  "Oualata-Mauritania" = "massina_timbuktu_arma",
  "Diré-Mali" = "futa_toro_segou_toucouleur",
  "Djenné-Mali" = "futa_toro_segou_toucouleur",
  "Hamdallahi-Mali" = "futa_toro_segou_toucouleur",
  "Mopti-Mali" = "futa_toro_segou_toucouleur",
  "Sofara-Mali" = "futa_toro_segou_toucouleur",
  "Tombouctou-Mali" = "futa_toro_segou_toucouleur",
  "Ménaka-Mali" = "mossi_kong_wassoulou",
  "San-Mali" = "mossi_kong_wassoulou",
  "Sikasso-Mali" = "mossi_kong_wassoulou",
  "Oussouye-Senegal" = "trarza_brakna_mauritania",
  "Misau-Nigeria" = "bornu_kanem_bagirmi",
  "Mubi-Nigeria" = "bornu_kanem_bagirmi",
  "Saka-Ethiopia" = "turco_egyptian_mahdist_nile",
  "Nekemte-Ethiopia" = "bahr_el_ghazal_azande_eq",
  "Zouar-Chad" = "bornu_kanem_bagirmi",
  "Bardaï-Chad" = "wadai_dar_al_kuti_tibesti",
  "Ain Farah Settlement-Sudan" = "wadai_dar_al_kuti_tibesti",
  "Al-Junaynah-Sudan" = "wadai_dar_al_kuti_tibesti",
  "al-Dalanj-Sudan" = "darfur_kordofan_mahdist",
  "An-Nuhūd-Sudan" = "darfur_kordofan_mahdist"
)

classify_sahel_zone <- function (e) {
  k <- as.character(e$key)
  if (k %in% names(zone_overrides)) return(unname(zone_overrides[[k]]))
  lat <- as.numeric(e$coords[[1]])
  lon <- as.numeric(e$coords[[2]])
  ctry <- as.character(e$country)
  if (ctry %in% c("Burkina Faso", "Ghana", "Togo")) return("mossi_kong_wassoulou")
  if (ctry %in% c("Guinea", "Guinea-Bissau", "Ivory Coast", "Sierra Leone")) return("futa_toro_segou_toucouleur")
  if (identical(ctry, "Eritrea")) return("turco_egyptian_mahdist_nile")
  if (identical(ctry, "South Sudan")) return("bahr_el_ghazal_azande_eq")
  if (identical(ctry, "Benin")) {
    if (lon >= 2.9) return("sokoto_caliphate_hausaland")
    return("mossi_kong_wassoulou")
  }
  if (identical(ctry, "Cameroon")) {
    if (lat < 7.0) return("sokoto_caliphate_hausaland")
    return("bornu_kanem_bagirmi")
  }
  if (identical(ctry, "Central African Republic")) {
    if (lat >= 7.0) return("wadai_dar_al_kuti_tibesti")
    return("bahr_el_ghazal_azande_eq")
  }
  if (identical(ctry, "Chad")) {
    if (lon >= 18.0) return("wadai_dar_al_kuti_tibesti")
    return("bornu_kanem_bagirmi")
  }
  if (identical(ctry, "Ethiopia")) {
    if (lat >= 8.5) return("turco_egyptian_mahdist_nile")
    return("bahr_el_ghazal_azande_eq")
  }
  if (identical(ctry, "Gambia")) {
    if (lon < -14.5) return("trarza_brakna_mauritania")
    return("futa_toro_segou_toucouleur")
  }
  if (identical(ctry, "Mali")) {
    if (lon >= -5.0) return("massina_timbuktu_arma")
    return("futa_toro_segou_toucouleur")
  }
  if (identical(ctry, "Mauritania")) {
    if (lon >= -8.5) return("futa_toro_segou_toucouleur")
    return("trarza_brakna_mauritania")
  }
  if (identical(ctry, "Niger")) {
    if (lon < 3.0) return("mossi_kong_wassoulou")
    if (lon >= 11.5) return("bornu_kanem_bagirmi")
    return("sokoto_caliphate_hausaland")
  }
  if (identical(ctry, "Nigeria")) {
    if (lon >= 12.25 && lat >= 10.0) return("bornu_kanem_bagirmi")
    return("sokoto_caliphate_hausaland")
  }
  if (identical(ctry, "Senegal")) {
    if (lat >= 13.8 || (lat >= 13.7 && lon < -15.0)) return("trarza_brakna_mauritania")
    return("futa_toro_segou_toucouleur")
  }
  if (identical(ctry, "Sudan")) {
    if (lat < 12.0 && lon < 31.5) return("bahr_el_ghazal_azande_eq")
    if (lon < 26.0) return("darfur_kordofan_mahdist")
    return("turco_egyptian_mahdist_nile")
  }
  "turco_egyptian_mahdist_nile"
}

sub_by_id <- setNames(summary_cache$subregions, vapply(summary_cache$subregions, function (x) x$id, character(1)))

entry_sub_ids <- vapply(all_entries, classify_sahel_zone, character(1))
zone_entries <- setNames(lapply(subregion_order, function (sid) {
  sub <- all_entries[entry_sub_ids == sid]
  pks <- vapply(sub, function (e) max(as.numeric(unlist(e$population))), numeric(1))
  sub[order(-pks, vapply(sub, function (e) e$name, character(1)))]
}), subregion_order)

build_gazetteer_df <- function (sub_list) {
  rows <- lapply(sub_list, function (e) {
    iso_code <- unname(iso_map[as.character(e$country)])
    if (is.na(iso_code)) iso_code <- toupper(substr(as.character(e$country), 1L, 3L))
    loc_str <- paste0(
      iso_code,
      ": ",
      fmt_eu_coord(e$coords[[1]]),
      ", ",
      fmt_eu_coord(e$coords[[2]])
    )
    data.frame(
      Settlement = as.character(e$name),
      Location = loc_str,
      `1500AD` = fmt_site_pop(e, 1500),
      `1700AD` = fmt_site_pop(e, 1700),
      `1780AD` = fmt_site_pop(e, 1780),
      `1860AD` = fmt_site_pop(e, 1860),
      `1890AD` = fmt_site_pop(e, 1890),
      Peak = fmt_site_peak(e),
      check.names = FALSE,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  })
  df <- do.call(rbind, rows)
  rownames(df) <- NULL
  df
}

n_excluded <- as.integer(summary_cache$wave_saturation_stats$ledger_excluded)
n_candidates <- length(all_entries) + n_excluded
n_obs <- as.integer(summary_cache$observation_count)
n_countries <- length(summary_cache$countries)

bench_nums <- c(1500, 1700, 1780, 1810, 1860, 1890)
bench_keys <- as.character(bench_nums)
n_active <- setNames(
  vapply(bench_nums, function (yr) sum(vapply(all_entries, function (e) !is.na(interp_site_pop(e, yr)), logical(1))), integer(1)),
  bench_keys
)
```

# Abstract

This gazetteer compiles geographic coordinates and dated population series for `r viscount_fmt_number(length(all_entries), 0L)` individually assessed settlements across the Sahel and Sudan between 1500AD and 1898AD, spanning `r viscount_fmt_number(n_obs, 0L)` historical observations across `r n_countries` modern countries. Screened from `r viscount_fmt_number(n_candidates, 0L)` candidate walled capitals, caravan oases, river ports and colonial communes (`r viscount_fmt_number(n_excluded, 0L)` duplicate orthographies and historical aliases excluded), the retained entries partition deterministically across ten historical sub-regions from Mauritania, Senegambia and the Niger Bend through Hausaland and Lake Chad to Darfur, the Turco-Egyptian Nile and Equatoria. Active interpolated sites rise from `r viscount_fmt_number(n_active[["1500"]], 0L)` settlements in 1500AD to `r viscount_fmt_number(n_active[["1700"]], 0L)` in 1700AD, `r viscount_fmt_number(n_active[["1780"]], 0L)` in 1780AD and `r viscount_fmt_number(n_active[["1860"]], 0L)` in 1860AD before consolidating at `r viscount_fmt_number(n_active[["1890"]], 0L)` in 1890AD, tracing urban trajectories from imperial Gao (68,6k), Birnin Gazargamu (62,4k), Gondar (62k), Niani (60k) and Timbuktu (58,4k) to nineteenth-century Kano (58,4k), Khartoum (60k), Kukawa (60k), Nioro du Sahel (95k) and Mahdist Omdurman (148k).

# Background

Early modern Sahelian and Sudanic urbanism operated across a vast savanna-and-steppe belt uniting trans-Saharan caravan terminals, riverine ports and fortified agrarian capitals [@Caillie1830TravelsThrough; @MacDonald2012WalledSegou; @Crawford1951FungSennar]. Along the western Saharan and Senegambian margin, oasis towns such as Chinguetti and Tichitt exchanged desert salt for gold and millet from Futa Toro, Segou and the Inland Niger Delta [@Chastanet1992SurvivalStrategies; @Houdoy1881SoudanFrancais]. Across the central and eastern Sudan, walled manufacturing capitals in Hausaland, fired-brick elite centres in Kanem-Bornu and caravan seats across Wadai, Darfur and Sennar sustained dense urban populations shaped by nineteenth-century Islamic reform movements, Turco-Egyptian expansion and Mahdist state formation [@Last1967SokotoCaliphate; @Magnavita2025NewLuminescence; @Ofahey1980StateDarFur; @Spaulding1985HeroicAge].

# Methodology

## Candidate Screening and Sub-Regional Partition

Candidate settlements were gathered from French Senegalese communal censuses, British Gambian and Sierra Leonean colonial returns, nineteenth-century traveller surveys [@Lyon1821NarrativeTravels; @Baikie1862NotesJourney], Arabic chronicles and archaeological wall-circuit mappings [@MacDonald2012WalledSegou; @Suleiman2007BirninZaria]. Out of `r viscount_fmt_number(n_candidates, 0L)` candidates situated within the `r viscount_fmt_number(summary_cache$total_area_km2, 0L)` km² domain bounded by geoBoundaries polygons [@Runfola2020GeoBoundaries], `r viscount_fmt_number(n_excluded, 0L)` duplicate orthographies and historical aliases were merged, leaving `r viscount_fmt_number(length(all_entries), 0L)` city-proper settlements across `r n_countries` countries. Each settlement maps cleanly to one of the ten historical sub-regions defined in the companion study.

## Population Interpolation and Table Layout

Every entry records city-proper populations anchored to attested historical dates without synthetic extrapolations or flat caps [@Hamza2004DorayiKano; @Aouatef2026PoliticalStructures]. Tables 1 to 10 present linearly interpolated populations at five benchmark years (1500AD, 1700AD, 1780AD, 1860AD and 1890AD) alongside each site's observed peak population and peak date, marking years outside a settlement's recorded chronological span with a hyphen (-).

# Testing and Validation

Across 397 spatially deduplicated city peaks (merging two co-located historical entries at Freetown), ordinary least-squares rank-size regression across the upper 180 settlements yields a Pareto slope of $q = 0,77$ ($R^2 = 0,98$; Figure \ref{fig:settlements-rank}), matching a multi-polar belt of regional capitals across West, Central and Nilotic Sudan rather than single-metropolis primacy [@Azarya1980TradersAnd; @Smaldone1962WarfareThe]. Cross-checking chronological bounds ensures alignment with documented foundation and abandonment dates, from post-1821AD Khartoum and post-1881AD Omdurman back to sixteenth-century Songhai and Funj capitals [@Crawford1951FungSennar; @Spaulding1985HeroicAge].

```{r fig3-ranksize, results='asis'}
viscount_figure(
  "figures/fig_03_rank_size.png",
  "Rank-size scaling across 397 spatially deduplicated settlements (top-180 OLS slope q = 0,77, R² = 0,98) and mean sub-regional density in 1890AD.",
  "fig:settlements-rank",
  arg3_options = list(max_height = "0.38\\textheight")
)
```

# Results

## Trarza, Brakna and Adrar Emirates

Table \ref{tab:zone1-sites} compiles `r viscount_fmt_number(length(zone_entries[["trarza_brakna_mauritania"]]), 0L)` settlements across Mauritania, northern and central Senegal and western Gambia, led by Saint-Louis (20,2k in 1891AD), Bakel (10,9k in 1863AD), Dakar (8,74k in 1891AD), Tichitt (8,35k in 1750AD), Rufisque (8,09k in 1891AD) and Chinguetti (6,85k in 1650AD) [@Chastanet1992SurvivalStrategies; @Houdoy1881SoudanFrancais].

```{r tab-zone1, results='asis'}
viscount_table(
  build_gazetteer_df(zone_entries[["trarza_brakna_mauritania"]]),
  "Individually assessed settlements in Trarza, Brakna and Adrar Emirates from 1500AD to 1890AD with peak populations.",
  arg3_options = list(label = "tab:zone1-sites")
)
```

## Bahr el Ghazal, Azande and Equatoria

Table \ref{tab:zone10-sites} compiles `r viscount_fmt_number(length(zone_entries[["bahr_el_ghazal_azande_eq"]]), 0L)` settlements across South Sudan, southern Ethiopia, eastern Central African Republic and southern Kordofan, led by Jima (12,4k in 1895AD), Deim Zubeir (12,2k in 1879AD), Yambio (8,42k in 1895AD), Bonga (7,88k in 1843AD) and Bangassou (7,84k in 1890AD) [@Lovejoy2012Transformations].

```{r tab-zone10, results='asis'}
viscount_table(
  build_gazetteer_df(zone_entries[["bahr_el_ghazal_azande_eq"]]),
  "Individually assessed settlements in Bahr el Ghazal, Azande and Equatoria from 1500AD to 1890AD with peak populations.",
  arg3_options = list(label = "tab:zone10-sites")
)
```

# Limitations

Three caveats govern this settlement ledger. First, documentary coverage is thickest in Senegambia, Sokoto Hausaland and the Nile corridor, whereas 65 of the 4.038 entries rest on single-date historical records and display hyphens outside their attested date [@Ofahey1980StateDarFur; @Dijk2000DroughtAnd]. Second, linear interpolation smooths sudden wartime evacuations or refugee peaks between recorded observations, as seen at Nioro du Sahel in 1892AD and Omdurman in 1895AD [@Houdoy1881SoudanFrancais]. Third, combined urban totals in Tables 1 to 10 exclude dispersed agrarian villages and pastoral groups, which are reconstructed in the companion regional study [@Meek1934BlackByzantium].

# Conclusion

Together, the `r viscount_fmt_number(length(all_entries), 0L)` individually assessed settlements document four centuries of Sahelian and Sudanic urban transformation from Songhai Gao and Funj Sennar through Hausa walled manufacturing capitals and nineteenth-century Islamic reform seats to Mahdist Omdurman, providing the urban anchor for NICETHI across `r n_countries` modern jurisdictions.

# Appendix

## Sub-Regional Gazetteer Summary

Table \ref{tab:gazetteer-summary} aggregates the individually assessed settlement counts and combined interpolated urban populations across all ten sub-regions at the six chapter benchmarks from 1500AD to 1890AD.

```{r tab-appendix-summary, results='asis'}
sum_rows <- lapply(subregion_order, function (sid) {
  sub <- zone_entries[[sid]]
  sums <- setNames(vapply(bench_nums, function (yr) {
    vals <- vapply(sub, function (e) {
      p <- interp_site_pop(e, yr)
      if (is.na(p) || p <= 0) 0 else p
    }, numeric(1))
    viscount_fmt_pop(sum(vals))
  }, character(1)), bench_keys)
  data.frame(
    `Subregion (Sites)` = paste0(sub_by_id[[sid]]$name, " (", viscount_fmt_number(length(sub), 0L), ")"),
    `1500AD` = sums[["1500"]],
    `1700AD` = sums[["1700"]],
    `1780AD` = sums[["1780"]],
    `1810AD` = sums[["1810"]],
    `1860AD` = sums[["1860"]],
    `1890AD` = sums[["1890"]],
    check.names = FALSE,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
})
tot_sums <- setNames(vapply(bench_nums, function (yr) {
  vals <- vapply(all_entries, function (e) {
    p <- interp_site_pop(e, yr)
    if (is.na(p) || p <= 0) 0 else p
  }, numeric(1))
  viscount_fmt_pop(sum(vals))
}, character(1)), bench_keys)
tot_row <- data.frame(
  `Subregion (Sites)` = paste0("All Sub-Regions (", viscount_fmt_number(length(all_entries), 0L), ")"),
  `1500AD` = tot_sums[["1500"]],
  `1700AD` = tot_sums[["1700"]],
  `1780AD` = tot_sums[["1780"]],
  `1810AD` = tot_sums[["1810"]],
  `1860AD` = tot_sums[["1860"]],
  `1890AD` = tot_sums[["1890"]],
  check.names = FALSE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
df_sum <- rbind(do.call(rbind, sum_rows), tot_row)
rownames(df_sum) <- NULL
viscount_table(
  df_sum,
  "Individually assessed settlement counts and combined interpolated urban populations across ten historical sub-regions from 1500AD to 1890AD.",
  arg3_options = list(label = "tab:gazetteer-summary")
)
```
